name: Shadowdark RPG Ruleset Pack
description: Fast-paced old-school dungeon crawling with real-time torch timers (1 hour), roll-to-cast spells, Luck tokens, and slot-based gear.

conditions.name: Total Darkness
conditions.description: No torch or light remaining. You cannot see. Disadvantage on all checks and attacks; attacks against you have advantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated and cannot move or speak. Attacks against you hit automatically and are critical hits.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Disadvantage on all checks and attack rolls.

conditions.name: Dying (0 HP)
conditions.description: Bleeding out. You die in 1d4 + Constitution modifier rounds unless stabilized.

actions.name: Melee Weapon Strike
actions.description: Make one melee attack with d20 + Strength mod vs target AC.

actions.name: Ranged Weapon Shot
actions.description: Make one ranged attack with d20 + Dexterity mod vs target AC.

actions.name: Roll to Cast Spell
actions.description: Roll d20 + Spellcasting Stat mod vs Spell DC (10 + Tier). Natural 1 triggers Wizard Mishap or Deity Penance. On failure, spell is lost for the day.

actions.name: Turn Undead
actions.description: Cleric rolls d20 + Wisdom mod vs highest undead level. Success paralyzes or destroys undead.

actions.name: Spend Luck Token
actions.description: Discard your Luck Token to reroll any one roll you just made.

features.name: Grit
features.description: Roll an additional talent at 1st level.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stout, subterranean fighters renowned for stonecraft and endurance.

features.name: Stout
features.description: Start with +2 HP and advantage on saves vs poison.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Fey beings with keen vision and ethereal longevity.

features.name: Fey Blood
features.description: +1 to spellcasting checks or +1 with ranged attacks.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small, cheerful, and remarkably stealthy survivors.

features.name: Stealthy
features.description: Advantage on checks to remain unseen or pass silently.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Armor-clad masters of steel and physical combat.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: +1 to attack and damage with your chosen weapon type.

classes.name: Priest
classes.description: Devoted holy warriors invoking miracles and turning the restless dead.

features.name: Holy Spellcasting
features.description: Cast Priest spells with Wisdom check (DC 10 + Tier).

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Arcane scholars commanding elemental forces and ancient wards.

features.name: Arcane Spellcasting
features.description: Cast Wizard spells with Intelligence check (DC 10 + Tier).

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: Silent shadows adept at lockpicking, trap disarming, and assassination.

features.name: Backstab
features.description: Advantage on attacks against unaware foes, dealing +1d6 damage.
